# Expected values for the removal of a finished pig farm (docs/rules/pig-farming.md, docs/rules/removal.md), captured from the original
# program in the emulator (ADR 0008): tools/GhidraDump/emulate.py, the verb remove with a finished pig farm (type 14, a large building,
# object code 3) at the flag 15,9 and the remove click on its node. Its flag pointer (+0xe) is set by hand, as a built site leaves it
# (0x43ef82); the pointer's high bytes are left out of the building's bytes. The player setup also runs 0x44579c, which writes the word at
# +0x158 that the pig farm's handler (0x42e0fa) reads; the part castle-off@300 sets the castle's building type to 0 before the pass 300
# (the pig farm's handler reads the pointer the code before it left, docs/rules/pig-farming.md, "The rank"). The lines are the verb's
# output, reduced to the changes of the map, the pig farmer (s3: a settler without a job the castle made the pig farmer), the flags, the
# building (b2), the table counts (c), and the generator (rng); the castle's knights and the carriers are left out. A scenario has the
# pig farmer inside waiting for grain (pig-inside), working with the node held (pig-working) or pausing (pig-pausing), out on the flag with
# a pig (pig-out, the click at the pass 12300 after the pig is made at 12261), and, with a grain from the castle's flag (put at the
# pass 600), the grain on its way to the pig farm (pig-grain-on-the-way) or on site and not yet taken (pig-grain-held). Not production
# code: no routine of the program is transcribed here, only values the program produced.
